description: This file defines a Flutter widget 'HomeScreen' that serves as the main screen of a learning application. It manages state, loads lessons from a repository, and displays an animated header, progress summary, and a list of lesson cards with navigation. It also contains several helper widgets for animations and UI effects.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the main home screen with header, lessons, and progress overview.

classes.name: _HomeScreenState
classes.description: State implementation for HomeScreen, managing data loading, UI building, and interactions.

classes.name: _AnimatedAppear
classes.description: A widget that animates its child appearing with a fade and slide effect, with optional delay.

classes.name: _AnimatedAppearState
classes.description: State class for _AnimatedAppear handling animation controller and build logic.

classes.name: _LessonCardHorizontal
classes.description: A widget representing a horizontally scrollable lesson card with progress bar and tap interactions.

classes.name: _LessonCardHorizontalState
classes.description: State class handling tap effects and UI for LessonCardHorizontal.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the widget state, triggering data load.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Fetches lessons from the repository and updates state.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI of the HomeScreen, including header, lessons list, and other components.
